narrative.overview:
The home screen is one matte plate seen from the piano bench: raised ivory letters, a braille mark, and each take embossed beneath as a row of dots. Hierarchy comes from size alone; there is no header bar, no bubbles, no chrome.

Embossed is a metaphor carried by form, not rendering: the plate is flat, dots are flat discs with smooth edges, nothing is bevelled or shadowed. One amber signal owns live state; every space descends from one 24 px cell and every size follows the learner's text scale.

The tools workspace is the same instrument opened up: same palette, focus language and spacing, with denser native widgets.
keyCharacteristics: One flat matte plate, ivory ink, one amber live signal that always travels with a word.
Atkinson Hyperlegible drawn smooth from the bundled face.
Size-only hierarchy, scaled live from 0.8 to 1.75.
Takes as flat dots per note grouped by measure; the measure to fix ringed amber.
One 24 px cell sets every space.
Every button names its key; focus is an always-visible ivory ring.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber means live now: only the six live states and the ringed measure, always beside a word.

rules.name: The Seven-to-One Rule
rules.body: Anything the learner must read is ivory or slate on the plate; faded is only the previous take.

rules.name: The Fill-Before-Clip Rule
rules.body: ADA's words take the largest size from 34 to 24 px that fits whole; only then an ellipsis.

rules.name: The Size-Is-Rank Rule
rules.body: Rank is size and weight, not colour, boxes or rules.

rules.name: The One Cell Rule
rules.body: Every space is the 24 px cell or a simple fraction of it.

rules.name: The No-Faked-Relief Rule
rules.body: No shadows, bevels or gradients; depth is a tonal step only.

dos: Do derive every space from the 24 px cell.
Do pair amber with a word, and use it only for the six live states and the ringed measure.
Do scale every size with the learner's text scale.
Do show each button's key on the button.
Do keep an ivory focus ring with a plate-coloured gap on every focusable control.
Do draw readable text from the bundled Atkinson Hyperlegible, keeping the widget's real text.
donts: Don't add shadows, bevels, gradients or faked relief; embossing is expressed by flat dots.
Don't carry meaning by colour alone: missed is a ring, live is a word.
Don't add history, bubbles, header bars or scrollbars to the plate.
Don't shrink take dots below the floor; wrap whole measures instead.
Don't ellipsize ADA's words above 24 px.
Don't use faded for anything the learner must read first.
